# FYI Club VIT Bhopal

> FYI Club, the Fraternity of Young Innovators, is the student-run technology and innovation club at VIT Bhopal University.

The club brings students together to build software, hardware, robotics, and other working prototypes. The chapter is based at VIT Bhopal University in Madhya Pradesh, India.

## Website

- [Home](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/): Overview of FYI Club, student projects, activities, events, and membership.
- [About](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/about): Club background, mission, and campus information.
- [Projects](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/projects): Student software and hardware project archive.
- [Events](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/events): Club workshops, meetups, and events.
- [Team](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/team): Student club team.
- [Gallery](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/gallery): Photos from club activities.
- [Join](https://fyiclubvitbpl.web.app/join): Membership information.
